name: Irvine
sourceLabel: Requirements quoted in HCD's letter to the City of Irvine (2025-03-27): a city email of 2025-02-18 (p. 2) and HCD's description of the City's position (pp. 1, 3). Not the city's current form.

items.text: "Pursuant to state ADU laws, the City is within our rights to restrict the separate sale of ADUs ... requests that you provide the required covenant to continue with your plan check review."
"Pursuant to Section 65852.2(a)(10), the City has not adopted a separate ordinance to allow the separate conveyance of the primary dwelling unit and ADU."
JADUs are not allowed in townhomes: the City treats a detached townhouse on its own lot as ineligible (as described by HCD).
"While State law provides for a 60-day shot clock for processing ADUs, that clock stops when the City provides plan check comments and restarts when the applicant resubmits."
